text:
mike_p: Starting canary now for the rate-limit threshold cutover. Rolling 5% traffic in us-west-2, enabling 'safety_net_stepdown' to allow gradual stepdown on spikes. Watch 429s and tail latency. I'll post config we pushed.

tara_ops: copying. which metric thresholds should we watch in Datadog? :eyes:

mike_p: Primary signals: 1) 429 rate > 0.5% over 5m 2) p95 latency increase > 100ms 3) token cost jump > 10% median. Any of those -> pause canary and auto-fallback. Also watch auth 401s from AcmePay customers.

eli_oncall: set alert thresholds on the canary tag? I can add temporary alerts. Suggest roll window 15m per subregion.

support_jess: FYI support saw a small 429 spike in last dry-run. Tagging customers: AcmePay, BetaOrg. I'll open targeted cases if they see errors.

sre_alan: Can you paste the exact rate policy blob so I can diff with prod? Want to confirm burst window and token bucket params.

mike_p: pasted below

```
# new policy snippet
rate_limit: {
  capacity: 1200
  refill_rate_per_min: 600
  burst_multiplier: 1.25
  safety_net_stepdown: true
  stepdown_decay_secs: 30
}
```

mike_p: We lowered burst_multiplier and enabled stepdown. Fallback policy is previous policy pinned as v1.2-fallback.

tara_ops: how to trigger fallback manually? CLI or console?

mike_p: console button -> Rollback -> 'force-fallback-to:v1.2-fallback', or from infra: `infractl rollout cancel --policy rate-limits --selector canary=3076543210`.

deploy-bot: (automated) deploy started: canary 3076543210 -> 5% us-west-2

eli_oncall: adding temporary dashboard panels: canary.429_rate, canary.p95_latency, canary.auth_401_rate. Will post links.

support_jess: request: please pause canary if any customer-facing 429s > 2 in 10m.

sre_alan: agree. Also include a synthetic at 95th percentile load to validate KV cache behavior.

mike_p: plan: 15m window, monitor, bump to 20% if stable for 30m, otherwise rollback. Escalation: if 429>0.5% or p95+100ms -> stepdown automatically and @eli_oncall + @sre_alan notified.

eli_oncall: linked dashboards https://dd.example.com/dashboards/abc123 (canary panels)

sre_alan: test rollback command in staging before prod push please.

mike_p: done in staging earlier today. staging runbook ID: RB-2026-45. Copy of rollback command: `infractl rollout revert --id 3076543210 --to v1.2-fallback`.

support_jess: I'll alert customers on watch if we flip. Standby.

eli_oncall: 3m in: no signal spikes. :thumbsup:

sre_alan: 12m in: minor auth-401 blip from AcmePay, tracing now. Could be token caching TTL mismatch with new stepdown. Investigating.

mike_p: lower stepdown decay to 15s for that region and re-evaluating. Will update config if confirmed.

tara_ops: updated CD patch to `stepdown_decay_secs:15` in canary. infractl patch applied.

deploy-bot: (automated) canary patch applied: stepdown_decay_secs=15

eli_oncall: 22m in: auth-401s back to baseline. p95 stable. No 429s. Recommend continue to 20% after 30m.

sre_alan: agreed. keep alerts for 2h post-rollout.

support_jess: marking AcmePay as notified and on-call for followups.

mike_p: thanks everyone. I'll proceed with staged increase at +20% next window at T+35m. If anything changes, call rollback. :alarm_clock:
